_comment: Battle actions, one list per officer post. skill: the skill (or stat) rolled. dc: fixed target, or vs: the enemy post whose skill opposes the roll. bands: range bands where it's allowed (0 Long, 1 Medium, 2 Close, 3 Grappled). Effects are implemented by id in scripts/combat/dice_combat.gd; numbers live here and in rules.json dice_combat.

rally.name: Rally the crew
rally.description: A word, a roar, a promise of plunder. Restores morale.

intimidate.name: Show them no mercy
intimidate.description: Hail them with threats. Their morale drops by how badly they lose the contest.

demand.name: Demand their surrender
demand.description: Order them to strike. Harder the steadier they are; your fearsome reputation helps. Success ends the fight.

duel.name: Seek out their captain
duel.description: Blade to blade on their quarterdeck. Win and their crew breaks; lose and you're wounded.

steady.name: Hold steady
steady.description: Stand where the crew can see you. +1 to all your other officers' rolls this round.

strike.name: Strike your colours
strike.description: Surrender. They'll strip your hold and take half your gold.

close.name: Close the distance
close.description: Bear down on them, one range band closer. Contested if they're trying to keep away.

open.name: Open the distance
open.description: Bear away, one range band further. Contested if they're closing.

gauge.name: Take the weather gauge
gauge.description: Get upwind of them: +2 to manoeuvres and gunnery while you hold it.

grapple.name: Lay her alongside and grapple
grapple.description: Grappling hooks and boarding: the fight goes hand to hand.

flee.name: Crowd on sail and run
flee.description: Break away for good. Faster, handier ships run better.

cut_loose.name: Cut the grapples
cut_loose.description: Hack through the lines and fall back to close range.

hold.name: Hold her steady
hold.description: A steady deck: +2 to your gunner's roll this round.

round.name: Broadside: round shot
round.description: Smash her hull, guns and rudder. Too much and your prize sinks.

chain.name: Broadside: chain shot
chain.description: Shred her sails and bring down masts. She'll struggle to run or manoeuvre.

grape.name: Broadside: grape shot
grape.description: Sweep her deck of men. Softens a crew before boarding.

chase.name: Fire the chase guns
chase.description: Long guns at bow and stern: a smaller shot, but it lands while you chase or flee.

join_boarders.name: Gun crews join the boarders
join_boarders.description: Leave the guns: +2 to your side's melee this round.

read_wind.name: Read the wind
read_wind.description: Call every shift of the breeze: +3 to your boatswain's roll this round.

shoals.name: Steer for the shoals
shoals.description: Your keel is shallower than hers. Lead her toward the shoals: she can't close or grapple this round, and your running is easier.

push.name: Boarders: push forward
push.description: Throw everyone at them: +2 to the melee roll, but the losses run high both ways.

hold_rail.name: Boarders: hold the rail
hold_rail.description: Fight from cover: -2 to the melee roll, but your losses are much lighter.

arm.name: Arm the boarders
arm.description: Cutlasses, pistols, grenadoes up from the arms chest: +2 to your melee rolls for the rest of the fight.

keep_order.name: Keep order below
keep_order.description: Stop the rot before it spreads: restores a little morale and halves morale losses this round.

plug.name: Plug the shot holes
plug.description: Stop leaks and fires, and patch the hull.

rigging.name: Splice the rigging
rigging.description: Repair sails and rigging under fire.

tend.name: Tend the wounded
tend.description: Patch men up and send some back to their stations. Morale rises when they see it.
